def safe_imread(path: Path):
    """
    Reads an image safely using OpenCV.
    Returns None if image cannot be opened.
    """
    img = cv2.imread(str(path))
    if img is None:
        print(f"Could not read: {path.name}")
        return None
    return img

def l1(a,b): return np.sum(np.abs(a-b))
def l2(a,b): return np.sqrt(np.sum((a-b)**2))
def chi2(a,b,eps=1e-10): return 0.5*np.sum(((a-b)**2)/(a+b+eps))
def cosine(a,b): return 1 - np.dot(a,b)/(np.linalg.norm(a)*np.linalg.norm(b)+1e-10)
def bhatta(a,b):
    a = a / (a.sum() + 1e-10)
    b = b / (b.sum() + 1e-10)
    val = np.sum(np.sqrt(a*b))
    val = np.clip(val, 1e-10, 1) 
    return -np.log(val)

# Mahalanobis setup
X = np.array(list(desc_db.values()))
cov = np.cov(X, rowvar=False)
inv_cov = np.linalg.inv(cov + np.eye(cov.shape[0])*1e-6)
def mahalanobis(a,b,inv_cov):
    d = a - b
    return np.sqrt(np.dot(np.dot(d.T, inv_cov), d))

metric_funcs = {
    "L1": l1,
    "L2": l2,
    "Chi-Square": chi2,
    "Cosine": cosine,
    "Bhattacharyya": bhatta,
    "Mahalanobis": lambda a,b: mahalanobis(a,b,inv_cov)
}

def rank(query_vec, desc_db, dist_fn, top_k=10):
    """
    Compare query descriptor to all database descriptors
    and return top-k most similar (sorted by distance ascending).
    """
    distances = []
    for name, vec in desc_db.items():
        d = dist_fn(query_vec, vec)
        distances.append((name, d))
    distances.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
    return distances[:top_k]

def plot_metric_grid(query_vec, metric_name, desc_db, data_dir, top_k=6, save=True):
    """Retrieve and plot Top-K results for a given metric."""
    dist_fn = metric_funcs[metric_name]
    results = rank(query_vec, desc_db, dist_fn, top_k=top_k)

    # Read and resize all valid images
    imgs = []
    for name, _ in results:
        path = data_dir / name
        img = cv2.imread(str(path))
        if img is not None:
            img = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
            imgs.append(cv2.resize(img, (120, 120)))
    if not imgs:
        imgs = [np.zeros((120,120,3), dtype=np.uint8)]

    # Combine into a horizontal grid
    grid = np.concatenate(imgs, axis=1)

    # Plot
    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 2.5))
    plt.imshow(grid)
    plt.axis("off")
    plt.title(f"Top-{top_k} retrieved using {metric_name} distance", fontsize=12)
    plt.tight_layout()

    # if save:
    #     save_path = FIG_DIR / f"retrieval_{metric_name.lower()}.png"
    #     plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    #     print(f"Saved figure: {save_path}")

    plt.show()

metrics = ["L1", "L2", "Chi-Square", "Cosine", "Bhattacharyya", "Mahalanobis"]
cols = len(metrics)
top_k = 6

plt.figure(figsize=(18, 4))

for j, m in enumerate(metrics):
    dist_fn = metric_funcs[m]
    results = rank(query_vec, desc_db, dist_fn, top_k=top_k)

    
    imgs = []
    for name, _ in results:
        img_path = DATA_DIR / name
        img = cv2.imread(str(img_path))
        if img is not None:
            img = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
            img = cv2.resize(img, (120, 120))
            imgs.append(img)
    if not imgs:
        # Handle metrics that produce no valid results
        imgs = [np.zeros((120,120,3), dtype=np.uint8)]

    # Concatenate horizontally
    grid = np.concatenate(imgs, axis=1)
    plt.subplot(1, cols, j + 1)
    plt.imshow(grid)
    plt.axis("off")
    plt.title(m, fontsize=10)

plt.suptitle("Metric Comparison for Same Query", fontsize=14)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
